answer: The delta test I would run is Bus driver CPC card with transport authority attestation: each card is periodic training hours logged by the transport authority, so a farm must train a hundred real drivers, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the anchor of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head. The ember is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
